ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, a person of mass M stands on a platform scale, one end of a suspension string of length R is tied to a small ball of mass m, the hand holds the other end of the suspension string, the small ball moves in circular motion in a vertical plane around the other endpoint of the suspension string, and the small ball can just pass through the highest point of the circular track, then which of the following statements is correct (　　)
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text: When the small ball is at the three positions a, b, and c, the readings of the platform scale are the same

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure, the person stands on the platform scale and holds one end of the suspension string in the hand; the dashed circle represents the track of the small ball doing circular motion in a vertical plane around the hand end. The mark a is at the horizontal position on the left side of the circular track, c is at the horizontal position on the right side of the circular track, and b is at the highest point of the circular track. The platform scale is below the person, and what it displays is the magnitude of the supporting force of the platform scale on the person. Then reason: Analyze the forces on the person; the person's gravity is Mg, the supporting force of the platform scale on the person is N, and the pulling force of the rope on the hand is along the direction of the suspension string. When the small ball is at a and c, the suspension string is horizontal, so the pulling force of the rope on the person is also horizontal and has no vertical component, and does not affect the reading of the platform scale, so N_a=N_c=Mg. When the small ball is at b, the highest point, the suspension string is vertical; the problem states that the small ball can just pass through the highest point, and the critical condition at the highest point of vertical circular motion is that the tension of the rope T_b=0, so the rope also has no vertical pulling force on the person, and the supporting force of the platform scale is still N_b=Mg. Therefore N_a=N_b=N_c.
